concept: Cold data: offload to S3 (Parquet) and query with Athena
tests: How to cheaply store rarely queried historical relational DB data while keeping SQL access.
expected: Export cold data to S3 as Parquet and query on demand with Athena. Triggers: "cold historical data rarely queried", "inflating primary database cost", "queryable cheaply via SQL".
why_not: Scaling up RDS — expensive; DynamoDB — NoSQL, unsuitable for ad hoc SQL; EBS snapshots can't be queried directly.
